name: crowdbake
description: Bake skeletal and procedural animation into GPU textures; render 100k animated crowd instances in a handful of draw calls (three.js).

scripts.bake:goobers: node tools/bake-goober.mjs --kind goober-biped --seed 7 --out tools/_out/goober-biped && node tools/bake.mjs --frames-dump tools/_out/goober-biped.frames.json --fps 40 --lods 5 --out public/baked/goober-biped && node tools/bake-goober.mjs --kind goober-quad --seed 12 --out tools/_out/goober-quad && node tools/bake.mjs --frames-dump tools/_out/goober-quad.frames.json --fps 40 --lods 5 --out public/baked/goober-quad && node tools/bake-goober.mjs --kind cat --seed 4 --out tools/_out/cat && node tools/bake.mjs --frames-dump tools/_out/cat.frames.json --fps 40 --lods 5 --out public/baked/cat
